CPP_SYNTAX_ERROR.message: Compilation failed. Check for missing expressions, semicolons, or mismatched braces.
CPP_SYNTAX_ERROR.remediation: Ensure all statements end with a semicolon and all braces are properly matched.

CPP_ASSIGNMENT_IN_IF.message: You used '=' inside an if condition. Did you mean '==' for comparison?
CPP_ASSIGNMENT_IN_IF.remediation: Replace '=' with '==' if you intended comparison.

CPP_ARRAY_OOB_LITERAL.display_name: Array Index Out of Bounds Literal
CPP_ARRAY_OOB_LITERAL.message: Index {use_index} is outside the valid range [0 ~ {def_size}) for array '{def_name}'.
CPP_ARRAY_OOB_LITERAL.remediation: Ensure the index stays within the declared array size.

CPP_NEGATIVE_INDEX_ACCESS.message: Array index {index} is negative, which accesses memory before the array begins.
CPP_NEGATIVE_INDEX_ACCESS.remediation: Ensure the index is greater than or equal to 0 before use.

CPP_INVALID_ARRAY_SIZE.message: Array size must be a positive integer. You provided: {size}.
CPP_INVALID_ARRAY_SIZE.remediation: Use a positive constant integer when declaring fixed-size arrays.

CPP_DIVISION_BY_ZERO_LITERAL.message: Divisor may be zero, which causes undefined behavior.
CPP_DIVISION_BY_ZERO_LITERAL.remediation: Add a condition to ensure divisor != 0 before division.

CPP_NULL_POINTER_DEREF.message: Pointer may be nullptr and is dereferenced without a null check.
CPP_NULL_POINTER_DEREF.remediation: Check if (ptr != nullptr) before dereferencing the pointer.

CPP_UNINIT_VAR_USAGE.message: Variable is used before being assigned a definite value.
CPP_UNINIT_VAR_USAGE.remediation: Initialize variables at declaration, e.g. int x = 0;

CPP_UNINIT_MEMBER.message: Class member may not be initialized in the constructor.
CPP_UNINIT_MEMBER.remediation: Initialize all member variables in the constructor initializer list.

CPP_IMPLICIT_NARROWING.message: Implicit conversion may lose precision or range.
CPP_IMPLICIT_NARROWING.remediation: Use static_cast to make the conversion explicit or use a wider type.

CPP_UNSAFE_CAST.message: C-style cast or reinterpret_cast may cause undefined behavior.
CPP_UNSAFE_CAST.remediation: Prefer static_cast or dynamic_cast where appropriate.

CPP_VOID_POINTER_USE.message: void* is used without casting to a concrete type.
CPP_VOID_POINTER_USE.remediation: Cast void* to the correct pointer type before dereferencing.

CPP_MISSING_BREAK.message: Switch case may fall through without a break statement.
CPP_MISSING_BREAK.remediation: Add break, return, or [[fallthrough]] to clarify intent.

CPP_NON_VOID_NO_RETURN.message: Function has a return type but not all control paths return a value.
CPP_NON_VOID_NO_RETURN.remediation: Ensure every control path returns a value consistent with the function type.

CPP_RESERVED_IDENTIFIER.message: Identifier uses reserved naming pattern (leading underscore or double underscore).
CPP_RESERVED_IDENTIFIER.remediation: Avoid identifiers starting with '_' or containing '__'.

CPP_FUNCTION_RETURN_LOCAL_REF.message: Function returns a reference to a local variable, which will be destroyed after the function returns.
CPP_FUNCTION_RETURN_LOCAL_REF.remediation: Return by value or return a reference to an object with a longer lifetime, such as a parameter or class member.

CPP_FUNCTION_RETURN_LOCAL_PTR.message: Function returns a pointer to a local variable, which will dangle after the function returns.
CPP_FUNCTION_RETURN_LOCAL_PTR.remediation: Avoid returning the address of local variables; instead return by value or point to dynamically allocated or longer-lived objects.

CPP_ARRAY_SIZE_NON_CONSTANT.message: Array size should be a compile-time constant, but here it depends on a non-constant expression.
CPP_ARRAY_SIZE_NON_CONSTANT.remediation: Use a constant expression for the array size or replace the built-in array with std::vector or std::array.

CPP_ALLOC_ZERO_SIZE_ARRAY.message: Allocating array with new[] and size 0 leads to undefined behavior.
CPP_ALLOC_ZERO_SIZE_ARRAY.remediation: Ensure array size is positive before calling new[].

CPP_VIRTUAL_CALL_FROM_CONSTRUCTOR.message: Calling virtual function from constructor; derived class is not fully constructed yet.
CPP_VIRTUAL_CALL_FROM_CONSTRUCTOR.remediation: Avoid virtual calls in constructors; use non-virtual or pass state via parameters.

CPP_DESTRUCTOR_EXCEPTION_UNHANDLED.message: Destructor may throw an exception, which can cause program termination.
CPP_DESTRUCTOR_EXCEPTION_UNHANDLED.remediation: Destructors should not throw; catch and handle exceptions inside the destructor.

CPP_REINTERPRET_CAST_UNSAFE.message: reinterpret_cast between incompatible types may cause undefined behavior.
CPP_REINTERPRET_CAST_UNSAFE.remediation: Prefer static_cast or dynamic_cast; use reinterpret_cast only when necessary and document the rationale.

CPP_CONST_CAST_ABUSE.message: Using const_cast to modify a const object leads to undefined behavior.
CPP_CONST_CAST_ABUSE.remediation: Avoid const_cast; redesign interfaces to avoid stripping const.

CPP_DYNAMIC_CAST_NULL.display_name: dynamic_cast Result Not Checked for nullptr
CPP_DYNAMIC_CAST_NULL.message: dynamic_cast may return nullptr; dereferencing without a null check causes undefined behavior.
CPP_DYNAMIC_CAST_NULL.remediation: Always check the result of dynamic_cast before dereferencing.

CPP_CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_EXPLICIT_MISSING.message: Single-parameter constructor allows implicit conversion; consider adding explicit.
CPP_CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_EXPLICIT_MISSING.remediation: Add explicit to prevent unintended implicit conversions.

CPP_VIRTUAL_DESTRUCTOR_MISSING.message: Base class with virtual functions should have a virtual destructor.
CPP_VIRTUAL_DESTRUCTOR_MISSING.remediation: Declare the base class destructor as virtual.

CPP_FLOAT_COMPARISON_DIRECT.message: Comparing floats with == or != is unreliable due to precision; use epsilon comparison.
CPP_FLOAT_COMPARISON_DIRECT.remediation: Use std::abs(a - b) < epsilon instead of a == b.

CPP_FUNCTION_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_VALUE_NOT.message: Default parameters must appear after all non-default parameters.
CPP_FUNCTION_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_VALUE_NOT.remediation: Reorder parameters so all parameters with defaults come last.

CPP_LOGIC_WRONG_CONDITION_OPERATOR.display_name: Wrong Operator in Condition (Bitwise vs Logical)
CPP_LOGIC_WRONG_CONDITION_OPERATOR.message: Using & or | instead of && or || in a condition may cause unexpected short-circuit behavior.
CPP_LOGIC_WRONG_CONDITION_OPERATOR.remediation: Use && for logical AND and || for logical OR in conditions.

CPP_ASSIGNMENT_OPERATOR_SELF_ASSIGN.message: Assignment operator should check for self-assignment to avoid resource corruption.
CPP_ASSIGNMENT_OPERATOR_SELF_ASSIGN.remediation: Add if (this == &other) return *this; at the start of operator=.

CPP_VOID_POINTER_ARITHMETIC.message: Pointer arithmetic on void* is invalid; void has no size.
CPP_VOID_POINTER_ARITHMETIC.remediation: Cast void* to a concrete pointer type before arithmetic.

CPP_C_STYLE_CAST.message: C-style cast (type)expr can hide errors; prefer C++ casts.
CPP_C_STYLE_CAST.remediation: Use static_cast, dynamic_cast, const_cast, or reinterpret_cast as appropriate.

CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_DEFINITE.display_name: Definite Array Index Out of Bounds
CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_DEFINITE.message: Access to array '{arrayName}' is definitely out of bounds. The maximum valid index is {maxValidIndex}, but the dynamically inferred index strictly falls within {indexInterval}.
CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_DEFINITE.remediation: Check the array size declaration and the index calculation logic. Ensure the index is never negative and never exceeds the array length minus one.

CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_SUSPECTED.display_name: Potential Array Out of Bounds Risk
CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_SUSPECTED.message: Potential out-of-bounds risk for array '{arrayName}'. The maximum valid index is {maxValidIndex}, but under certain control flow paths or loop extremes, the index may reach the interval {indexInterval}.
CPP_DYNAMIC_ARRAY_OOB_SUSPECTED.remediation: Consider adding a bounds check (e.g., `if (i >= 0 && i <= {maxValidIndex})`) before accessing the array, or review loop termination conditions to prevent off-by-one errors.
